---
name: product-discovery
description: Convert an owner prompt into confirmed requirements before implementation.
---

# Product Discovery

1. Preserve the owner's wording and intent.
2. Extract actors, goals, pages, workflows, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
3. Separate explicit requirements, reasonable assumptions, and unresolved questions.
4. Flag high-impact decisions: clinical content, payment, delivery, privacy, hosting, and cost.
5. Do not start implementation while blocking questions remain.
6. Return a concise requirements brief and owner approval checklist.
